summary: All 17 findings across the three reviews (2 blocker, 2 major, 6 minor, 7 note) were checked against the current head (342287c71) by reading the actual SQL/TS bodies and re-running the underlying evidence, not by trusting the fix report's prose. Every finding's claimed fix is present and matches the fix report's description exactly: ADV-1007-1's ack read now joins through the Work's own trade_invoices row with a matched-particulars-plus-time-ordered join and a content tie-break (0275 lines 697-736); ADV-1007-2's matcher walks the merge tree with a recursive CTE over merged_into; ADV-982-1's resolve_party recut (section 10, marker #982R2) reads the name tier before treating a multi-hit TIN as a refusal, falls through on agreement, and unions both identifiers' candidates with matched_on; S-1's probe now rides packages/runtime/src/workRoutes.ts's new POST /api/work/trade-invoice/duplicates route through the same toDbTradeInvoice the admission uses, and apps/web/lib/work/api.ts's probeTradeInvoiceDuplicates posts there instead of PostgREST; S-2/S-3/STD-1 (matched_on sentence, matched_on rendering, formatMyr) are all present verbatim in trade-invoice-form.tsx and en.json; S-5's work-detail.tsx now reads getTradeInvoiceDuplicateAck; ADV-1007-3's client_inactive arm and ADV-1007-4's typed invalid_total/invalid_due_date guards are both in 0275's record_trade_invoice_duplicate_ack; STD-2/STD-3's doc corrections and the migration header's corrected 'purely additive... the ONE body it does recut is 0274's' language are all present; S-4 and ADV-982-2 are accepted deviations recorded in packages/db/README.md as the fix report claims, and STD-4 is a disclosed non-defect. Every claimed test cell (p1007.ack.rode_this_recording, p1007.probe.across_a_merge, p982.tin.shared_with_a_name, p982.tin.shared_name_decides, p1007.probe.client_inactive, p1007.ack.typed_shape, p1007.probe.never_posting, the two api.test.ts 1007.web cells) exists verbatim in the test files under those exact names. Independently re-running the full gate chain reproduced the fix report's counts exactly: packages/db touched-file battery 52/52/0/0 pass; operation-census 10/10/0; rig-isolation 23 tests/22 pass/0 fail/1 skip (T19 skip only, reset flags never set); packages/runtime trade-invoice-unit + work-routes-unit 55/55/0; check-frozen-workflows OK (312 files, no manifest diff); check-parts-parity OK; pnpm typecheck exit 0; CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint exit 0 (no raw-colour-selector hit, no #NNNN-shaped assertion text found); the three touched web unit files (trade-invoice-form, work-detail, api.test.ts) 108/108/0 combined; the whole apps/web unit suite 4859 tests/4857 pass/0 fail/2 skip, exit 0 (exact match); the e2e trade-invoice-walk spec on the lane's own Playwright triple (3510/3511/3512) 15 passed, exit 0. Nothing above minor remains open and nothing new broke.

per_finding_recheck.evidence: packages/runtime/src/workRoutes.ts:1412 adds POST /api/work/trade-invoice/duplicates, which runs the same toDbTradeInvoice the admission uses and calls clara.probe_trade_invoice_duplicates_for over the actor-explicit twin. apps/web/lib/work/api.ts:432 probeTradeInvoiceDuplicates posts to that route instead of PostgREST and no longer imports callDoor. Web unit and e2e gates above are green through this path.

0275 lines 697-736: clara.get_trade_invoice_duplicate_ack now joins clara.trade_invoice_duplicate_acks to the Work's OWN clara.trade_invoices row on kind/counterparty_id/document_date/total_cents/normalised reference, requires acknowledged_at <= w.created_at, and orders by acknowledged_at desc, ack_digest desc, id desc. A Work with no trade-invoice row answers NULL. Matches the fix report's description exactly.

0275 section 2 (clara._trade_invoice_duplicate_matches, lines ~229-298) walks merged_into with 'with recursive family' and compares ti.counterparty_id against the whole family, indexed by ix_counterparties_merged_into.

0275 section 10 recuts clara._trade_invoice_resolve_party (lines 764-994, marker #982R2): the v_tin_hits > 1 arm now reads the name tier first, resolves on agreement (name reaches exactly one of the TIN holders), and otherwise unions the TIN-reached and name-reached candidates each carrying matched_on. 0274 itself is untouched (grep shows no edits to that file); the prestate at 0275 lines ~124-144 is two-valued (0274 post-image sha or a body already carrying #982R2) exactly as the fix report describes.
apps/web/messages/en.json has a distinct party_ambiguous_tin sentence and trade-invoice-form.tsx reads detail.matched_on off the refusal to pick the sentence via REFUSAL_BY_MATCH.

trade-invoice-form.tsx renders matched (from candidate.matched_on, restricted to the four-value MATCHED_ON set) via t(`candidates.matchedOn.${matched}`), and en.json has all four matchedOn labels (registration/tin/name/tin_and_name).

packages/db/migrations/0184_work_cancel_ordering.sql:715-716 confirms clara.settle_work_run forces v_outcome to 'completed' whenever a committed receipt exists, regardless of p_outcome — the argument the fix report makes for keeping 'expired' in the never-posting filter without a code change. Recorded as an accepted deviation per the reviewer's own required_fix option.

apps/web/components/work/work-detail.tsx imports getTradeInvoiceDuplicateAck, calls it via loadDuplicateAck in the mount effect, and renders duplicateAck state. work-detail.test.tsx 55/55 pass with no hang (67 unmount() calls present, matching the fix report's discipline claim).
trade-invoice-form.tsx imports formatMyr from @/lib/bank/money and calls formatMyr(m.totalCents); no formatCents or hardcoded "RM {value}" remains in the duplicate-banner path.
0275's REDO-SAFE section (line 104) has no duplicated sentence; it reads once, as the fix report describes.
packages/db/README.md's 0275 section (~line 3054 onward) states the migration's own statement shapes and cross-references the fix round; no understated summary remains.
Not a code defect; the fix round's own report states it killed no process it did not start and the earlier implementer's kill was already disclosed with PIDs. No code artifact to check.

0275 (lines ~380-432) gives clara.probe_trade_invoice_duplicates the same client_inactive arm (detail='{"reason":"client_inactive"}') the admission twin carries, with a comment confirming this was measured, not assumed.

0275's clara.record_trade_invoice_duplicate_ack (lines 536-660) raises typed invalid_total and invalid_due_date CLR10 exceptions before the insert, restating clara._assert_trade_invoice_basis's own guards. p1007.ack.typed_shape drives both arms and is present in trade-invoice-duplicate-probe.test.mjs.

Fixed by the same ADV-1007-1 change: the order by clause ends in ack_digest desc, id desc, giving a deterministic content tie-break rather than a random primary key, exactly as required_fix asked as a fallback.

packages/db/README.md's 0274 section (~line 77-87) records that a name is never a conflict partner, only the two identifiers are — the calibration the finding asked to have documented rather than changed. No code change was required by the ticket as written; this is now narrower in scope than before ADV-982-1's fix (a TIN reaching several parties no longer outranks the name silently).

notes: Every one of the 17 findings from the three review reports (spec, standards, adversarial) was independently re-verified against the actual code on head 342287c71, not just against the fix report's own claims — reading the SQL bodies of 0275's get_trade_invoice_duplicate_ack, _trade_invoice_duplicate_matches and the recut _trade_invoice_resolve_party directly, reading workRoutes.ts's new route and api.ts's rewritten probeTradeInvoiceDuplicates, reading the CONTEXT.md and packages/db/README.md diffs, and grepping every claimed new test cell name into existence in the actual test files. The full gate chain the lane's rules require (touched db test files with the full --import chain, operation-census, rig-isolation without reset flags, runtime unit files, check-frozen-workflows, check-parts-parity, root typecheck, CI-mode lint, the whole apps/web unit suite, and the lane's e2e walk on its own Playwright triple) was re-run from scratch in this recheck session and reproduced the fix report's counts exactly in every case, with zero deltas. Nothing above minor remains open, and nothing else regressed.
